2:164.text: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the

ships which sail through the sea with that which benefits people, and what Allāh has sent down from the heavens of rain, giving life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and dispersing therein every
directing of the winds and the clouds controlled between the heaven and earth are signs for a people who use reason.

2:165.text: , among the people are those who take other than Allāh as equals
love Allāh. But those who believe are stronger in love for Allāh. And if only they who have wronged would consider
that all power belongs to Allāh and that Allāh is severe in punishment.

2:166.text: when those who have been followed disassociate themselves from those who followed
see the punishment, and cut off from them are the ties

2:167.text: Those who followed will say, "If only we had another turn
so we could disassociate ourselves from them as they have disassociated themselves from us." Thus will Allāh show them their deeds as regrets upon them. And they are never to emerge from the Fire.

2:168.text: O mankind, eat from whatever is on earth
lawful and good and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

2:169.text: He only orders you to evil and immorality and to say about Allāh what you do not know.
